stories.title: Tabarak Dar appointed Temporary National Coach for ACC Trophy Elite campaign
stories.subTitle: ACC Trophy Elite 2010, Kuwait
stories.summary: The Hong Kong Cricket Association has appointed Tabarak Dar as Temporary National Coach for the upcoming ACC Trophy Elite Cup 2010 which will be held in Kuwait from 31 March to 9 April 2010.

stories.title: Hong Kong squad named for ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup 2010
stories.subTitle: ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup 2010, New Zealand
stories.summary: The national selectors have finalized the Hong Kong squad for the ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup 2010 to be played in New Zealand from 16-30 January 2010.

stories.title: Hong Kong squad named for ACC Twenty20 Cup 2009
stories.subTitle: ACC Twenty20 Cup 2009
